titles.title: I Want to Have a Baby
I Want to Have a Child

description:
Seung-hee, who has little interest in dating or men, gave up on marriage early on. However, after being diagnosed with early menopause, an unexpected longing for a baby starts to sprout within her... She doesn't need a man, but she needs sperm. She hates marriage, but she wants a child. As she hurriedly searches for a way to have a baby, her male best friend Jae-hyun—who possesses superior genes—suddenly catches her eye. Looking at his overwhelmingly outstanding traits, Seung-hee gets a brilliant idea.
